snippet.title: The Finals Season 12 Gameplay Reveal | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Season 12 of The Finals brings PRIME TIME, a huge update featuring overhauled destruction, maps and new ways to play. You won't want to miss out on the next evolution of this explosive team based FPS.

Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010
